Estimate weighted coverage

Source: R/estimate.R
estimate_coverage.Rd

Produces design-based coverage estimates with confidence intervals for one or more vaccines, optionally within survey domains.

estimate_coverage(
  design,
  vaccines = NULL,
  evidence = "card_or_recall",
  by = NULL,
  prefix = "cov_",
  level = 0.95,
  deff = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  ci_method = getOption("vaxsurvR.ci_method", "normal")
)

estimate_antigen_coverage(design, vaccine, by = NULL, ...)

Arguments

design

A vcs_design(), or a vcs_data object which will be passed to vcs_design().

vaccines

Vaccine names. Defaults to every vaccine with a derived coverage column.

evidence

Definition of vaccination. Ignored when the coverage columns already exist and redirect = FALSE.

by

Domains, as a one-sided formula or character vector, e.g. ~health_zone or c("province", "sex").

prefix

Prefix of the coverage columns.

level

Confidence level.

deff

Compute design effects. TRUE uses the with-replacement reference variance (Kish's design effect). Pass "F" for survey's finite-population variant, but note it returns Inf whenever the weights sum to the sample size.

na.rm

Exclude children whose status is unknown. TRUE by default: unknown status is not counted as unvaccinated.

ci_method

"normal" (default) for symmetric limits on the design standard error, or "wilson" for the survey-modified Wilson interval recommended by the WHO 2018 reference manual (a Wilson interval at the effective sample size n / deff). The global default can be changed with options(vaxsurvR.ci_method = "wilson").

vaccine

A single vaccine name.

...

Passed to estimate_coverage().

Value

A tibble of class vcs_estimate with columns indicator, domain, the domain variables, numerator, denominator, estimate, se, conf_low, conf_high, n_unweighted, deff, neff (effective sample size), icc (ANOVA intracluster correlation over first-stage clusters) and ci_method.

See also

estimate_dropout(), estimate_zero_dose(), vcs_design()

Examples

d <- derive_vaccination_status(vcs_example, evidence = "card_or_recall")
des <- vcs_design(d)

estimate_coverage(des, vaccines = c("BCG", "PENTA1", "PENTA3", "MCV1"))
#> <vcs_estimate: 4 row(s)>
#>   evidence : card_or_recall
#> # A tibble: 4 × 13
#>   indicator domain    numerator denominator estimate     se conf_low conf_high
#>   <chr>     <chr>         <dbl>       <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>
#> 1 BCG       <overall>       218         253    0.852 0.0235    0.806     0.898
#> 2 PENTA1    <overall>       227         252    0.907 0.0155    0.876     0.937
#> 3 PENTA3    <overall>       137         255    0.543 0.0302    0.484     0.602
#> 4 MCV1      <overall>       151         253    0.608 0.0320    0.545     0.671
#> # ℹ 5 more variables: n_unweighted <dbl>, deff <dbl>, neff <dbl>, icc <dbl>,
#> #   ci_method <chr>
estimate_coverage(des, vaccines = "PENTA3", by = ~stratum)
#> <vcs_estimate: 2 row(s)>
#>   evidence : card_or_recall
#> # A tibble: 2 × 14
#>   indicator domain stratum numerator denominator estimate     se conf_low
#>   <chr>     <chr>  <chr>       <dbl>       <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl>    <dbl>
#> 1 PENTA3    rural  rural          52         125    0.423 0.0375    0.349
#> 2 PENTA3    urban  urban          85         130    0.661 0.0448    0.573
#> # ℹ 6 more variables: conf_high <dbl>, n_unweighted <dbl>, deff <dbl>,
#> #   neff <dbl>, icc <dbl>, ci_method <chr>
estimate_antigen_coverage(des, "PENTA3", by = ~stratum)
#> <vcs_estimate: 2 row(s)>
#>   evidence : card_or_recall
#> # A tibble: 2 × 14
#>   indicator domain stratum numerator denominator estimate     se conf_low
#>   <chr>     <chr>  <chr>       <dbl>       <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl>    <dbl>
#> 1 PENTA3    rural  rural          52         125    0.423 0.0375    0.349
#> 2 PENTA3    urban  urban          85         130    0.661 0.0448    0.573
#> # ℹ 6 more variables: conf_high <dbl>, n_unweighted <dbl>, deff <dbl>,
#> #   neff <dbl>, icc <dbl>, ci_method <chr>
